##Synopsis##

Weak ridge of high pressure over Scotland and the North Sea with a developing area of low pressure to the south of Iceland.


##Wind##

South or southeast 2 to 4, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area at first, increasing 3 to 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, mainly in the west.


##Visibility##

Good.
